rationale.provenance-auditability: evidence-linked auditable structural record so humans can review AI changes
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: AI diffs outpace inspection; reviewers can't control opaque generated code
rationale.oversight-explanation: consensus graph makes AI work legible; navigator projects, reduces cognitive load
rationale.hitl-workflow: human-gated commit/rollback control surface over structural deltas
rationale.rules-based-checks: tests, static analysis, parity contracts, drift checks as grounded evidence
rationale.risk-routing: high consensus entropy escalates to human input over threshold
rationale.oversight-theater: reviewers demoted to rubber-stamping opacity, lacking info to control
rationale.metrics: proposes oversight metrics: comprehensibility (cognitive load), intervention distance, entropy
rationale.risk-quality: focal treatment of AI-code comprehensibility, fragility, structural decay
rationale.risk-overreliance: approve-on-vibes over-trust; trust calibration is core motivation
